match_strategy.postgresql: cast(synonyms AS text) ILIKE escaped pattern

runtime_observation.method: code + fixture audit (no production DB mutation)
runtime_observation.note: Phase 2B does not invent a synonyms table. Cast-to-text may match substrings inside JSON punctuation; PT-link + active + dimension gates keep noise bounded.

negative_rule: Synonyms linked to a different Product Type must not match products of another PT.
